svg.title: To see the contraction identity componentwise, denote the lift of the independent index by Wa(b, p), where a is the dependent two-form index and b the independent two-form index. Then P b symbol1(p)b,iWa(b, p) = Va,i(p). Contracting this equality with symbol1(−p)a,h and summing over a gives uh,i by (TEL2). This is precisely the two-curl representation, with no omitted polarization or identification of the two momentum slots. More generally repeated independent divisions obey the recursion η0(σ) = σ, K0 = 1, ηt+1(σ) = ηt(σ/4), Kt+1(σ) = Tm(σ)Kt(σ/4), where m is the ambient coordinate count. Each step preserves the contractions in the other independent blocks because their symbols do not vary with the divided block. For this application only t = 1, m = 4 is needed. These prices depend on the input strip, not on the torus period or on s. The tensor spaces, the harmonic-set check and the two identities in (TEL2) give the two-leg construction used in both loop-moment applications below.
